description: This file defines the PercentageFormatter class used for formatting percentage numbers in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It extends BaseFormatter and provides a static method for formatting values as percentages according to custom formats.

classes.name: PercentageFormatter
classes.description: A class responsible for formatting floats or integers as percentage strings based on specified formats, extending BaseFormatter.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as a percentage string according to a specified format string.
